 Zach LaVine fills stat sheet Friday against Trailblazers 
 by Chris Schommer | Kings Correspondent | Sat, Oct 24th 2026, 11:36am EDT 
 Zach LaVine filled the stat sheet for the Kings Friday night, recording two steals, blocking one shot, grabbing five rebounds, dishing out one assist, and scoring 22 points (6-15 FG, 3-9 3PT, 7-7 FT) in a 128-120 loss to the Trailblazers. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 LaVine has been solid on both ends of the floor to begin the season, finishing with four or more rebounds and 22 or more points in each of the first two contests. The 31-year-old will look to avoid injury issues as he looks to offer fantasy managers another reliable option in the Kings starting five, averaging 25.0 points, 2.5 assists, and 4.5 rebounds per game to go along with a usage rate of 25.7% so far this season.
